params.name: start
params.description: The start date, in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-mm-DDTHH:MM:ssZ), of the time range, inclusive

params.name: end
params.description: The end date, in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-mm-DDTHH:MM:ssZ), of the time range, exclusive

params.name: metrics
params.description: A comma-separated list of metrics to use in the report query

params.name: dimensions
params.description: A comma-separated list of dimensions to use in the report query

params.name: granularity
params.description: The level of granularity for returned data. Possible values are "hour", "day", "month".

params.name: domain
params.description: A comma-separated list of domain names used to filter results

params.name: bundleId
params.description: A comma-separated list of bundle IDs used to filter results

params.name: auction
params.description: A comma-separated list of auction types used to filter results. Possible values are "googleOb", "amazonTam", "waterfall", "headerBidding", "serverToServer", "nimbus", "springserve", "publica", "bidmachine"

params.name: propertyType
params.description: The property type by which to filter the results by. Possible values are "web" or "app"

items.docs: Get custom reporting data for a publisher
